metrics.label: Operating profit
metrics.title: Final-year operating profit
metrics.definition: Income minus running costs over 1992, the third and final year. Excludes vehicle purchases and construction but includes loan interest.

metrics.label: Company value
metrics.title: Company value
metrics.definition: The company's value at the end of 1992, its last completed quarter.

metrics.label: Fleet
metrics.title: Fleet
metrics.definition: Road vehicles in the final save, counted after reloading it independently.

metrics.label: Profit per vehicle
metrics.title: Profit per vehicle
metrics.definition: 1992 operating profit divided by the final fleet. A game that ends with no vehicles ranks last.

metrics.label: Cargo per year
metrics.title: Cargo delivered
metrics.definition: Units of cargo of every type delivered during 1992.

metrics.label: Margin
metrics.title: Operating margin
metrics.definition: 1992 operating profit as a share of 1992 income.

metrics.label: Tool calls
metrics.title: Tool calls
metrics.definition: Game tool calls the model made across the whole game.

metrics.label: Cost per game
metrics.title: Cost per game
metrics.definition: API cost per game in US dollars: as reported by Claude Code and Pi, and estimated at list price for GPT-6 Astra. Cheapest ranks first. Models with no recorded cost (the Codex GPT Sol runs and the Cursor Grok runs) are unranked.
